theme: Two days to Croatia — clear the runway.
greeting: A quiet Sunday at the St Pete house with the girls, and the last full day before the trip swallows the week. The calendar is empty; the to-do list is not.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This was due yesterday and it isn't just a preference — it unlocks or cancels the Oct 18–Nov 1 St Pete Airbnb and car, both of which book while you're in Croatia. If Maine wins, flights and cold-weather gear for six all book this month. Decide before you fly, not from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Settle the Sept 20–Oct 5 rental hedge
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow is your own decision point: keep the refundable Full Size SUV backup at TPA unless Mike's car has a written delivery window by then. The day before Croatia is the last clean moment to settle it.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Eurowings Discover ticket shows zero checked bags. Pull it up on the operating carrier's site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy bags online before Tuesday — two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on and counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and the marina transfer
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 night after the charter and the Komolac → Cavtat transfer still aren't booked, and the St Pete landing-gap nights of Sept 20–22 have no lodging either. Onboard connectivity is poor, so all of it has to be locked from dry land before you fly.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: The weekly 15-minute board sweep — owners and dates on everything.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann wants to reconnect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn InMail this morning after a bounced email — he's checking whether you're still at KPMG and hoping to pick the thread back up. A short reply before the trip keeps the networking line warm.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions — a Nautilus Cannes Festival note among them.

resolved.title: UN PRI call with Conor Kehoe
resolved.detail: You asked to push it past the trip; Kate confirmed Sept 4 she's holding the diary until you're back — nothing owed now.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Early autumn brings winter squash and cipolline onions to their sweet, roasting best.

tasks.title: Confirm Nautilus boarding time and arrange the return transfer
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)
Pack the travel larder bin before the Sept 8 handoff
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The 15-minute Sunday review with Mike is already behind you — the board's swept for the week.
Nothing else is on the calendar; the day is yours to close out the Croatia bookings while there's still dry land under you.
A quiet evening at the St Pete house with the girls, two days out from the flight.
